newsitem.title: UK: Reliance plans roadshows for stg bond.
newsitem.headline: Reliance plans roadshows for stg bond.

text.p: Reliance Industries Ltd, India's largest private sector company, is planning roadshows for its debut sterling Eurobond, joint lead manager HSBC Markets said on Monday.
Merrill Lynch is the other joint lead manager for the deal, bankers said.
The roadshows begin on Wednesday July 16 in London and end on Friday July 18 in Scotland, HSBC said, adding that terms were to be determined after investor presentations were completed.
Reliance Industries is rated Baa3 by Moodys and BB+ by S&P. --Denise Manning, London newsroom, +44 171 542 7658
